C005_notbad.series: You're not bad at this game
C005_notbad.outcome: By the end, viewers have 3 practical habits for one-touch obstacle games and want to try them.

slides.head: You're not bad at Impact Zero. So why do you keep losing?
Habit 1: you stare at the block. Look at the gap instead.
slides.sub: But what if the gap keeps moving?

slides.head: Habit 2: you react late. Read the next two obstacles, not the next one.
slides.sub: So why do you still clip the edge?

slides.head: Habit 3: you play scared. Commit to the line and hold it.
35 courses to fix it. $2.99 on iPhone.
